title: rbGyanX shipped NTCP model parameters
description: The LKB / relative-seriality parameter values rbGyanX itself uses, exposed so a comparison against them is arithmetic rather than recalled. Generated from engine/config/site_params_ntcp_default.yaml; a test asserts the two stay in step.
applicability: These are the tool's own defaults, not a clinical standard. A site that overrides them in site_params_ntcp_user.yaml should ship its own pack.
